# blendnewyork

> > blendnewyork is a local discovery platform connecting people with independent businesses, farms, restaurants, and cultural experiences across New York, Long Island, and the Hudson Valley.

The site curates locally-owned establishments ranging from Italian bakeries and Mediterranean restaurants to u-pick farms, custom clothing makers, and entertainment venues. blendnewyork emphasizes supporting local manufacturers, family-owned businesses, and regional producers throughout the New York metro area.

## Key Topics

- Long Island

## Local Food & Dining

- [Ferrara Bakery & Cafe](https://blendnewyork.com/ferrara-bakery-cafe): Ferrara Bakery & Cafe: historic Italian bakery in Little Italy, NYC
- [Scarr's Pizza](https://blendnewyork.com/scarrs-pizza): Scarr's Pizza: 100% natural stone-milled flour pizza, Lower East Side
- [Ayhan's Shish Kebab](https://blendnewyork.com/ayhans-shish-kebab): Ayhan's Mediterranean & Turkish cuisine in Port Washington & Baldwin, LI
- [Strong Hearts](https://blendnewyork.com/strong-hearts): Strong Hearts vegan café serving comfort food in Syracuse, NY
- [Vazzano • Taste of Italy](https://blendnewyork.com/vazzano-taste-of-italy): Vazzano Italian café, bakery & gelato shop in Mahwah, NJ
- [La Delice Pastry Shop](https://blendnewyork.com/la-delice-pastry-shop): La Delice Greek pastry shop: custom cakes & wedding cakes on Third Ave NYC
- [Michael's Pastry Shop](https://blendnewyork.com/michaels-pastry-shop): Michael's Pastry Shop: Italian bakery on Avenue R in Brooklyn

## Farms & Local Markets

- [Love Apple Farm](https://blendnewyork.com/love-apple-farm): Love Apple Farm in Ghent, NY: u-pick berries & fruit in Hudson Valley
- [Holiday Market at Sands Point Preserve](https://blendnewyork.com/holiday-market-sands-point-preserve): Holiday Market event featuring local makers at Sands Point Preserve
- [Great Jack O'Lantern Blaze 2021](https://blendnewyork.com/great-jack-o-lantern-blaze): Great Jack O'Lantern Blaze: 7,000+ carved pumpkins at Hudson Valley venues

## Local Manufacturing & Makers

- [Made in NYC](https://blendnewyork.com/made-in-nyc): Made in NYC nonprofit supporting local manufacturers & BIPOC businesses
- [Apparel Production Inc.](https://blendnewyork.com/apparel-production-inc): Apparel Production Inc: NYC garment manufacturer, domestic & overseas
- [GUREJE](https://blendnewyork.com/gureje): GUREJE Brooklyn custom clothing: hand-dyed fabrics & wedding outfits

## Fashion & Lifestyle Brands

- [Rebecca Minkoff](https://blendnewyork.com/rebecca-minkoff): Rebecca Minkoff luxury handbags & accessible bohemian fashion brand
- [BCBGMAXAZRIA & BCBGENERATION](https://blendnewyork.com/bcbgmaxazria): BCBGMAXAZRIA & BCBGENERATION fashion brands at NY retail locations
- [Puracy](https://blendnewyork.com/puracy): Puracy plant-based, non-toxic home & body care products from Austin, TX

## Entertainment & Arts

- [Michelle Wolf](https://blendnewyork.com/michelle-wolf): Michelle Wolf comedian profile: Netflix specials & stand-up comedy
- [Nick Kroll](https://blendnewyork.com/nick-kroll): Nick Kroll comedian, creator of Netflix's Big Mouth animated series
